summary: Added all-day event support to the CalDAV serializer, HTTP create/update/read paths, and repository exposure. All-day events now round-trip as DATE values (timezone-independent, exclusive end), edits preserve all-day representation, and mixed DATE/DATE-TIME values are rejected.
follow_up: T14 (recurrence) must extend all-day canonicalization to recurring all-day series; the repository currently excludes recurring events from DAV exposure.
important_context: CaldavIcalEvent now uses a timing: CaldavIcalTiming enum (Timed|AllDay) instead of flat start_utc/end_utc/timezone fields — any downstream consumer must migrate.
All-day events store ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) with exclusive end; the serializer converts to ICS DATE form (YYYYMMDD) via iso_to_ics_date.
list_events_in_range converts the query's UTC range endpoints to UTC dates for all-day overlap matching.
